verdict.rationale: Bevy is an open-source Rust game engine and app framework, and the evidence pack documents no outbound HTTP webhook callbacks that a consumer can register. The only remote-interface mention is the community bevy_brp tooling built on the Bevy Remote Protocol, which is not a webhook subscription mechanism. The OpenAPI probe found no API surface either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
